scope: DXF reader callback coordinate preparation when dxfRW::read is explicitly called with applyExtrusion=true; no source-profile or support claim

authority.title: Autodesk TEXT (DXF)
authority.rule: TEXT first and second alignment points (groups 10 and 11) are in OCS; group 210 is the extrusion direction; group 50 is text rotation.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: 2D text entities use OCS coordinates; the arbitrary-axis algorithm defines the OCS basis from the extrusion vector.

behavior: DRW_Text::applyExtrusion transforms the insertion point and alignment point through the existing entity arbitrary-axis basis when an extrusion was explicitly present.
The local rotation angle and extrusion normal remain unchanged; the angle remains relative to the OCS X axis.

The processText and INSERT-owned processAttrib paths invoke the transform only when dxfRW::read(..., applyExtrusion=true) is selected. Existing ATTDEF finalization uses the same DRW_Text implementation.
The default false option leaves parsed coordinates in OCS, preserving existing consumers' behavior.

optionStates: false preserves all original OCS coordinates
true delivers transformed insertion/alignment points and preserves angle 30 degrees and normal (1,0,0)
